text_en: Robbie Fowler considers Salah's rather selfish attitude this season not to be a mistake. According to him, the attitude is still within normal limits. "He is not really greedy or truly selfish, so I don't want to judge him that way. But I think there has been a change in the way he plays at the moment." "He is now more focused on his desire to score goals, where he appears ambitious to become a good goalscorer. I think at moments like these, he needs to act a little selfishly, and I think he has that at the moment," Fowler said. The man who scored 183 goals for Liverpool also stressed that selfishness is not a bad trait for a striker. For Fowler, a striker needs selfishness in order to score many goals. "I am not saying selfishness is good or bad. But if you look at great strikers, whether they play for Liverpool or not, you can see that they are a bit greedy for goals." "I think greed for scoring goals is good for him, and I am also sure it is good for this team," he asserted. This season, Mohamed Salah has scored 19 goals and provided eight assists in 33 matches played for Liverpool. Jakarta The second day of the 2019 MotoGP pre-season test was held again at the Sepang Circuit, Malaysia, Thursday (7/2/2019). Monster Energy Yamaha showed its strength again through rider Maverick Vinales. He set the fastest time, outpacing Alex Rins (Suzuki Ecstar) and Jack Miller (Pramac Ducati). Vinales set a best lap of 1 minute 58.897 seconds. He was well ahead by 0.527 seconds over Rins, while Miller trailed by 0.620 seconds. Repsol Honda rider Marc Marquez, who was the fastest on the first day of the MotoGP pre-season test, this time failed to keep his position. He finished in eighth place, 0.893 seconds behind Vinales. Valentino Rossi, who said he liked the new Yamaha engine, was in sixth place, behind Andrea Dovizioso and Cal Crutchlow. Rossi started today's test session well, even briefly setting the fastest time after completing the first hour. However, not long after, Rossi's time was beaten by Dovizioso and Crutchlow. Competition among riders on the second day was fierce. As many as 19 riders were separated by less than one second. However, in the final stages of the test, Vinales recorded a significant lap time. Repsol Honda rider Jorge Lorenzo was the only rider absent from the MotoGP pre-season test in Malaysia. He is still recovering from a wrist injury he suffered at the end of last season. - The draw for the FA Cup quarter-finals was held on Monday (18/2/2019). Manchester United were confirmed to meet Premier League club Wolverhampton Wanderers. Eight clubs remain in the FA Cup. Six of those eight clubs come from the Premier League and the rest from the Championship. Manchester United, Manchester City, Brighton and Hove Albion, Crystal Palace, Wolverhampton Wanderers and Watford represent the Premier League. The two Premier League clubs that will face Championship clubs are Manchester City and Brighton. Manchester United, who knocked out Chelsea to reach the quarter-finals, will face a tough opponent, Wolverhampton. In the 2018-19 season, the club coached by Nuno Espirito Santo has shown brilliant performances. Wolverhampton has become a dark horse and has sat in the top 10 until the 26th Premier League matchweek. In addition, Wolverhampton is known as a hard-working club with a physical advantage. Manchester United manager Ole Gunnar Solskjaer acknowledged that Wolverhampton could be a stumbling block for The Red Devils in the FA Cup. "We have to play away again and our opponent is Wolverhampton. They cannot be taken lightly," said Solskjaer. "We have to get through this the hard way. Wolverhampton is a tough opponent," Solskjaer said. The two teams had already played each other in the first half of the Premier League season. At that time, Manchester United ended the match with a 1-1 score. Source: Bola.com Watch live broadcasts of Premier League, La Liga, Ligue 1 and Europa League matches here

Liputan6.com, Jakarta Women's national team Jakarta PGN Popsivo Polwan will meet Jakarta Pertama Energi in the Proliga final, held at GOR Amongrogo, Yogyakarta, on Saturday, 23 February 2019. Through this duel, Jakarta PGN Popsivo Polwan is ready to repeat its success in Proliga 2012 and 2013. However, Popsivo Polwan's struggle will certainly not be easy. This is because the opposing team, Jakarta Pertama Energi, as defending champion, will not easily give up the title. "We have not enjoyed being champions for a long time, so naturally we want to take the title from Jakarta Pertanian Energi," said Alit SA, assistant manager of Jakarta PGN Popsivo Polwan, at a press conference held in Yogyakarta, Friday (22/2/2019). Adit is optimistic that his squad can win even though in the two matches of the final four earlier, Amalia Fajrina and team were always defeated by Pertamina Energi. "In the grand final, we don't want to lose again, this is a matter of life and death," the speaker said. In terms of head-to-head this season, Popsivo did indeed lose 3-1 to Pertamina. Pertamina's three wins were obtained in the regular round and the final four. Meanwhile, Popsivo's only win against Pertamina occurred in the first round.
